deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting maintenance window 04/15 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-6001 (functional shadow index + compact backfill). Claim within 10m or release slot. canaries=2.
Owen: Plan: build shadow index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, run chunked backfill workers, then atomic rename under a very short ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock for final swap. Backfill throttle default=300 r/s, auto-throttle on replica lag.
Priya: Please pin canaries to release-3.3.0-dbindex to avoid schema/runtime mismatch. If canary fails, revert canary to release-3.2.9. Also gating the new call path behind feature_flag:email_index_ok.
SRE-oncall: Adding preflight probes: replica lag, long tx count, and node memory pressure. Autothrottle rules: if replica_lag > 20s for >90s reduce to 120 r/s; if >40s for >60s pause workers and page #eng-sre. Will set pager cooldown to 30m for noise suppression.
Emma: I'll own cutover. I'll be on from 01:45-03:30 UTC and will run smoke checks. Smoke: GET /api/v1/profile?email=test@acme.com should be <180ms post-swap.
Owen: Runbook snippets:
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle in transaction');
SELECT application_name, state, write_lag FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 3;
-- progress
SELECT migration_id, phase, total_chunks, done_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-6001';
```
Priya: SQL (sanitized):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS users_email_shadow_idx ON users ((lower(email))) WITH (fillfactor=90);
-- background chunked workers fill rows until done
-- swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_shadow_idx RENAME TO users_email_idx; COMMIT;
```
Owen: Safety: rename old index to users_email_idx_old immediately after swap and schedule async drop after 20m. This gives quick revert path without needing to rebuild.
SRE-oncall: Documented rollback options: 1) Abort pre-swap: stop workers, keep old index active (no service impact). 2) Post-swap quick revert: under short lock rename active->tmp, old->active (brief lock ~200-700ms). 3) Full rebuild if old index dropped (expensive). Add explicit steps in ops playbook.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required before proceeding to global rollout. Auto-abort on failed preflight checks. Release note tag: m-6001 will be included in release-3.3.0.
Emma: I'll paste smoke timestamps here during canary. If profile query >=180ms or p99 auth latency rises >15% we abort.
Priya: Also suppress duplicate "index_build" metrics for 40m to avoid alert fatigue.
SRE-oncall: Will mute corresponding alerts and annotate dashboards with migration id.
Owen: Claiming slot now. deploybot: start canaries at 02:00 UTC and post health updates to this thread.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Canary rollout scheduled. Will post canary status and final go/no-go here.
